estimand: SD of canonical-scene equally phase-integrated area-weighted L-infinity error for two keep-referenced continuous PSNR utility contrasts

future_frozen_gate.inconclusive: interval crosses 0.05 dB or upper-bound distance exceeds 0.025 dB
future_frozen_gate.population: uniform random draw over the four frozen grid origins within each unseen canonical scene

limitations: The estimand applies only to the predeclared equal mixture of four grid origins; it does not bound a fixed or worst origin.
The same 32 development scenes support paired variance diagnosis but are not confirmation and do not increase independent n.
All primary means are withheld; feasibility cannot establish target stability.
Training-overlap data, confirmation, NH-HAZE, canary, and locked test are not accessed or counted.
No result authorizes Stage 2, training, model selection, or deployment.
scope: Variance-only development-screening precision supplement for a predeclared uniform-random grid-origin estimand; all primary means are withheld.

selection.method: same first 32 canonical scene digests under the frozen parent salt
